next_step_summary: PR #268 is the second bounded provider corrective after PR #266. It adds strict local response-contract validation, bounded HTTP-200 response reads, safe malformed-envelope/model-output fallback, structured quota/RetryInfo parsing, narrow daily-quota detection, finite retry hints, and separate per-model/global attempt caps while preserving the Flash-only route gemini-3.6-flash -> gemini-3.5-flash. The next and final provider-harness corrective before Codex review is attempt ledger, per-model reporting, recursive report redaction, fail-fast exhausted-route lifecycle, and checkpoint consistency. No real Gemini run is permitted before that chain is complete.
